# Labyrinth BJJ Wharton

> Jiu-jitsu and kickboxing gym in Wharton, Texas, part of Labyrinth BJJ. Kids kickboxing and jiu-jitsu, women's self defense jiu-jitsu, adult jiu-jitsu. Lead instructor: Joe Herrera, a brown belt under Prof. Anthony Curry. The first class is free.

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org). Every fact here is also on the pages linked beneath it; if the two ever disagree, the page is right and this file is stale.

## The essentials

- **Address**: 201 N Houston St, Wharton, TX 77488
- **Phone**: (281) 393-7983
- **Email**: info@labyrinth.vision
- **First class**: free
- **Programs**: kids kickboxing and jiu-jitsu, women's self defense jiu-jitsu, adult kickboxing (Tuesday and Thursday), adult jiu-jitsu (adult jiu-jitsu times not announced yet)
- **Lead instructor**: Joe Herrera, brown belt under Prof. Anthony Curry
- **Map**: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=201+N+Houston+St+Wharton+TX+77488

## Class schedule

- Tuesday, 5:00 PM to 6:00 PM: Kids Kickboxing
- Tuesday, 6:00 PM to 7:00 PM: Adult Kickboxing
- Wednesday, 5:00 PM to 6:00 PM: Kids Jiu-Jitsu
- Wednesday, 6:00 PM to 7:00 PM: Women's Self Defense Jiu-Jitsu
- Thursday, 5:00 PM to 6:00 PM: Kids Kickboxing
- Thursday, 6:00 PM to 7:00 PM: Adult Kickboxing
- Friday, 5:00 PM to 6:00 PM: Kids Jiu-Jitsu
- Friday, 6:00 PM to 7:00 PM: Women's Self Defense Jiu-Jitsu

## Pricing

- Grand Opening Membership: $150/mo. Grand opening price

## Part of Labyrinth BJJ

Labyrinth BJJ was founded in 2021 by Prof. Anthony Curry and is ranked in the top 1% of academies nationally on jits.gg (#39 of 7,869 as of September 24, 2026). Those results belong to the whole Labyrinth team, not to the Wharton gym. Main site: https://labyrinth.vision
